data.one_liner: UI-rich slider, range slider, and range selector widgets with numeric and date support.
data.what_it_does: Provides native Dart widgets for single value sliders, range sliders, and range selectors that support numeric and date values. Includes rich customization features like tooltips, ticks, labels, and integration with charts.
use_when: You need standard or vertical sliders and range selectors with numeric or date filtering.
You require advanced features like tooltips, custom tick intervals, and custom label formatting.
avoid_when: You cannot use a commercial or Syncfusion community license in your project.
You only need a basic Material slider and want to avoid adding a third-party UI library.
strengths: Comprehensive feature set including support for date values, tooltips, ticks, and labels.
Supports both horizontal and vertical orientations along with range selectors and charts integration.
weaknesses: Requires a commercial or Free Syncfusion Community license.
data.setup_notes: Requires a Syncfusion commercial or community license.
